C.DC_bias_scope: Read approximately from manufacturer reference-only2016 characterization curve; not a guaranteed minimum capacitance. Open-input node approaches12V and loses capacitance; closed DIF atabout1.5..2V has much smaller bias loss. Effective C varies during the transition.
C.Cmax_scope: 1uF*1.10 initial tolerance*1.15 temperature allowance; intentionally does not take credit for DC-bias reduction. This is an engineering envelope, not an aggregate guaranteed corner including all ageing/manufacturing interactions.

steady_LED.VF_scope: Engineering cold/current allowance; datasheet1.65V max is at2.6mA25C only.
steady_LED.closed_total12V_current_scope: For the retained VF assumption, adding the parallel shunt diverts current from LED but does not change total current throughR101+R161. Actual VF/current shifts are prototype parameters.

contact_transient.scope: Simple monotonic local-RC bound before cable inductance/surge; Rline limits discharge that would otherwise be contact/ESR limited.0.8W initial pulse and about0.11mJ are compared with the CRCW-HP pulse curves, not mistaken for continuous power. Repetitive/hot-contact/cable surge qualification remains pending.

timing.startup_scope: On power-up with an open contact, C charges throughLED/Rshunt and1.2k;220R is outside this open-contact charging branch. Raw activeLOW can occur. Rshunt provides defined charging after LED current becomes small. Simple initialLED bound11.11mA is below15mA derated absolute limit at105C. Button/action qualification remains required.
timing.TLP_input_hysteresis_scope: Datasheet does not specify an IFHL/IFLH hysteresis pair. Toshiba application note nevertheless shows clean slow-edge operation of TLP2363; do not claim it necessarily chatters on slow edges.

defined_OFF_model.model: Remove the LED, retainingR_LED+Rshunt chargingC. The real forward-conducting LED only accelerates charging compared with this conservative passive comparison model.
defined_OFF_model.leakage_scope: Combined capacitor/TVS/PCB/cable leakage sinking the openDIF node.100uA is a declared design/test envelope, not a claim that all unspecified field wiring and15V TVS variants guarantee it across temperature.
defined_OFF_model.postfilter_scope: Uses3V3-5%,10k/470R+1%,100nF+10%+15%temperature allowance,TLP50uA output leakage andMCP1uA input leakage; initialIN0V andMCP VIH0.8VDD. Geometric/input timing and resistor-temperature assumptions remain engineering envelopes.
defined_OFF_model.qualification_comparison: About23.64ms without leak or30.08ms at the declared100uA leak corner, below40ms between three distinct20ms observations under these model assumptions. This is not a guaranteed all-EMI pulse cutoff or an unconditional assembled-board startup timing guarantee.
defined_OFF_model.temperature_resistor_scope: Timing calculation above uses initial resistor tolerance; generic4.7k TCR,ageing,cable effects and capacitance interactions remain prototype checks. The separate DC IF calculation also gives a100ppm/K*65K engineering corner.

input_prefilter.bipolar_noise_scope: TVS stays at connector with a short return. Rline decouples external cable and limits local C current; reverse D protects LED reverse voltage. C filters both polarities of short node-voltage disturbance, while long or high-energy faults remain TVS/resistor/layout limits. No12/24V sustained-wiring-fault or completed EFT/surge qualification is claimed.
